notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.content:
General Changes

 Added contextual information labels to inform players of available controls in specific scenarios.


Minigame Changes

Squashers

 Significantly increased block spawn rate and speed.
 Reduced the occurrence of Black Hole blocks.


Snowball Fight

 Huge Snowballs now roll 30% faster.
 Snowball hit radius increased by approximately 15%.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where Custom Win Score settings were not correctly synchronized to clients.
